description: Header file defining the API for SurfaceTexture platform interactions in Android, including function prototypes, callback types, and external dependencies.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_routeAcquireANativeWindow
methods.description: Returns the native window associated with the given SurfaceTexture.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_routeAttachToGLContext
methods.description: Attaches the SurfaceTexture to a specified OpenGL texture context.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_routeDetachFromGLContext
methods.description: Detaches the SurfaceTexture from its current GL context.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_routeRelease
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the SurfaceTexture.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_routeUpdateTexImage
methods.description: Updates the texture image from the SurfaceTexture.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_routeGetTransformMatrix
methods.description: Retrieves the transformation matrix for the current texture.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_routeGetTimestamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the current frame.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_routeFromSurfaceTexture
methods.description: Creates an ASurfaceTexture instance from a Java SurfaceTexture object.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_getCurrentTextureTarget
methods.description: Returns the current texture target of the SurfaceTexture.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_takeConsumerOwnership
methods.description: Attaches an ASurfaceTexture in a detached state to a consumer.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_releaseConsumerOwnership
methods.description: Detaches a SurfaceTexture from a consumer context.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_dequeueBuffer
methods.description: Returns the next available hardware buffer from the SurfaceTexture.
